title: MarkerUser becomes MarkerBodyUser with a parameter markerType
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG7.15: MarkerUser takes bodies only and always provides Position and Orientation; as MarkerBodyUser it gets a parameter markerType that selects what it provides - Position, Position and Orientation, possibly Coordinates and others; the old C++ files removed.
releaseNotes: MarkerUser is renamed to MarkerBodyUser (type name BodyUser). Its new parameter providedMarkerType says what it provides: exu.MarkerType.Position (default) or exu.MarkerType.Position | exu.MarkerType.Orientation together with the rotationMatrixUserFunction; Assemble refuses a rotation function without Orientation, Orientation without it, and other values. The parameter is not called markerType, because that is the key of the type name in every marker dictionary.
